This should be Precedence(door_open, key_lost) hard. Clause 3 is also wrong. The task requires "whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open" (prevent has_door_key without door_open). The candidate uses RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open), which allows has_door_key to happen before door_open if it ever happens, violating the preference to keep the door open while holding the key. This should be Precedence(door_open, has_door_key) soft.
